name: JUNIPER FM-1
author: Fergus
tagline: a six-voice polysynth for the FM-1
description: A six-voice polysynth inspired by the Juno-106: one DCO per voice with saw, pulse/PWM, sub and noise, a high-pass, a resonant four-pole low-pass, one ADSR, an LFO with delay, and the stereo chorus I, II and I+II.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp. Unofficial: not affiliated with or endorsed by Roland or M-VAVE.
